about: WoW Forever's release phases, in release order. The client already carries content the game has not opened yet; what a phase lists (and everything only it gives: loot, quests, recipes) shows as Later instead of missing until the phase opens. opens: the date it opens (YYYY-MM-DD), or null while Blizzard has not announced one. maps: instances by English name or map id. npcs, objects, quests, items, spells: ids (npcs also by English name). See docs/PHASES.md.

phases.name: First raids
phases.source: Blizzard's raid preview: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open five weeks after launch. Map 3002: a raid the client keeps encrypted (no Map row, two raid encounters), so one of the two new raids. Quests: The Forging of Quel'Serrar, given in Dire Maul, whose blade only Onyxia's breath tempers (2026-11-18). The follow-ups of the Head of Onyxia turn-ins (For All To See, Celebrating Good Times, The Journey Has Just Begun), whose givers stand in the open world (2026-11-19)

phases.name: Feast of Winter Veil
phases.source: Feast of Winter Veil: WoW Forever launched on 2026-11-04 and the holiday has not come round since, so live Forever has not handed these items out yet (the user's rule of 2026-11-18 for holiday items). Blizzard has not announced Forever's holiday calendar: the date is the next start in the realm's own game_event table. Items: Filled Festive Mug, Fresh Holly, Mistletoe (2026-11-19). Forever's new A Winter Veil Gift: quest 99145 and the gift it hands out, item 286210 (Wowhead names only the reward; no giver, ender or text in any source yet, 2026-11-27)

phases.name: Lunar Festival
phases.source: Lunar Festival: WoW Forever launched on 2026-11-04 and the holiday has not come round since, so live Forever has not shown these yet (the user's rule of 2026-11-18 for holiday content). Blizzard has not announced Forever's holiday calendar: the date is the next start in the realm's own game_event table (event 7). Quests: Mossheart the Elder and Frostleaf the Elder, Forever's two new elders, whose NPCs no source names yet (2026-11-27)

phases.name: Later dungeons
phases.source: In the client but not among the 9 new launch dungeons; Blizzard plans two more dungeons per 2027 update

phases.name: Later raids
phases.source: In the client, no date announced. Quests: the Thunderfury (Rise, Thunderfury!) and Atiesh chains, taken and handed in outside the raids their pieces drop in; the Ahn'Qiraj war effort and gates (The Alliance/Horde Needs Singed Corestones!, The Champion Returns, Bang a Gong!) and Naxxramas' Fall of Kel'Thuzad and Omarion's Handbook, whose givers or items stand outside the raids (2026-11-18). Creatures: Zul'Gurub's Edge of Madness bosses Gri'lek, Hazza'rah, Renataki and Wushoolay, which the core's Zul'Gurub script summons at the Brazier of Madness (no spawn row, and the summon list cannot see a summon whose entry the script computes) (2026-11-19). Items: the Cenarion Circle field duty of the Ahn'Qiraj war effort in Silithus (Logistics and Combat Task Briefings and Assignments, Cenarion Logistics Badge, Unsigned and Prepared Field Duty Papers, Mark of Remulos: Wowhead Forever's list pages name only Silithus or the war effort's own quests for them), and Omarion's Handbook, which only Naxxramas' quest 9233 hands out (2026-11-19). Follow-ups of raid-only quests whose givers stand in the open world: Agent of Hydraxis, the rewards for the Head of Nefarian (The Lord of Blackrock), the Ahn'Qiraj scepter chain (The Path and The Hand of the Righteous, Anachronos, Long Forgotten Memories, A Pawn on the Eternal Board, The Might of Kalimdor), The Wrath of Neptulon and Ramaladni's chain (2026-11-19). A Proper String, whose Mature Black Dragon Sinew a creature that is not spawned also lists, and which follows The Ancient Leaf of Molten Core; The Fate of Ramaladni, the start of Ramaladni's chain: the realm disables both with its closed raids (2026-11-23) The Classic Cenarion Circle and Ahn'Qiraj patterns (Dreamscale Breastplate, Spitfire and Sandstalker, Ironvine and Bramblewood, Heavy and Light Obsidian Belt): no source gives them on live, where Vargus and Aendel Windspear in Cenarion Hold sell Forever's own Goregasher, Clutchlord, Bileblister, Hivethrasher, Scalegut and Broodwatcher plans and patterns instead (Icy Veins, the Forever changelog and the realm agree); the Obsidian belt plans dropped in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj (2026-11-27)

phases.name: Later battlegrounds
phases.source: In the client since build 69876 but not announced (2026-11-19): Blizzard's new battleground is Darkspear Islands, and Wowhead Forever records no creature, object or quest in Battle for Gilneas, so nobody has played it on live

phases.name: Not out yet
phases.source: Items the server gives in no way and whose Wowhead Forever page, read, names no source either (no drop, vendor, quest, craft, container, skinning or fishing): live WoW Forever does not hand them out yet. They come back by themselves when a page read again (about every 30 days) names a source (rule, user decision 2026-11-18). Spells in the client that nothing teaches on live WoW Forever: Wowhead's Forever pages list no trainer, quest, item, talent or perk for them, and no client spell teaches them (2026-11-18): Teleport: Dalaran, Lacerate rank 4, Voice of Truth, Improved Seal of Fury; 33 new profession recipes the client keeps encrypted (no spell record, no name) and Wowhead does not list (2026-11-18). Items that teach a spell (recipes, mounts, pets) and that nothing hands out on live WoW Forever (2026-11-18): Wowhead's Forever list pages name no source for them (no drop, vendor, quest, craft or container) or do not list them at all: holiday items whose holiday has not come round since launch (Lunar Festival rockets and lanterns, Love is in the Air, Hallow's End), patterns and formulas nobody has found yet, mount colours the newest build no longer carries, Season of Discovery formulas. Quests of the Scourge Invasion (Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind and the other capitals): the event is not on WoW Forever, Wowhead Forever's events calendar has none (2026-11-17). Mounts nobody can get on live WoW Forever (2026-11-18): devilsaurs, druid moose, warden sabers and the Caravan Kodo (their items still encrypted in the client, not on Wowhead), and Cerulean Prideclaw, Crimson Rooster, Dark and Green Skeletal Horse, Regal and Swift Regal Galestrider, Spectral Wolf Pack, Verdant Sea Turtle, Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion and Venomhide Ravasaur (on Wowhead's Forever pages with no drop, vendor, quest or other source)

phases.name: Promotions
phases.source: Items live WoW Forever gives only outside the game (2026-11-18): Wowhead's Forever pages name a promotion as their only source (trading card loot: Riding Turtle, White Tiger Cub, Hippogryph Hatchling; the Lashling buds, Tiny Bronze Whelpling), or the server's only quests for them have no giver because the game hands them out by code (collector's edition 'Welcome!' pets 13582-13584, iCoke voucher pets 22780, 22781). The collector's edition Gift Vouchers 14646-14651 that start those 'Welcome!' quests: the game puts them in a new character's bags by code (2026-11-18). Items live WoW Forever gives only outside the game (2026-11-19): the iCoke vouchers 19642, 22822 and 23227 and the Summer Gift Package the voucher's quest (Redeem iCoke Gift Box Voucher) hands out; the trading card loot Tabard of Flame, Tabard of Frost, Upperdeck Tabard #3, Perpetual Purple Firework and Carved Ogre Idol, which Wowhead Forever's list pages give one source code (14) and nothing else. Moved to Black Market (2026-11-20): the Riding Turtle, White Tiger Cub, Hippogryph Hatchling, three Lashling Buds and Tiny Bronze Whelpling, which Wowhead Forever says live sells on the Black Market. Paid editions and promotions (2026-11-20; Blizzard news, Wowhead's pre-order guide, Icy Veins and warcraft.wiki.gg): Skyborne Heroic Pack Cerulean Prideclaw 280544, Ensemble: Shen'dorei Skyseer's Garb 271755 (pieces 271746-271754), Veteran Adventurer's Rucksack 280623, Shen'dorei Windwell 280740; Skyborne Epic Pack Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion 280611, Ensemble: Veteran Adventurer's Outdoor Wear 279182 (pieces 279173-279181), Pachimari 280614, Panda Collar 281166, Zergling Leash 281167, Diablo Stone 281168 (the Forever copies, next to Pachimari; no source names which id the pack gives), Lordaeron Forever Tabard 280404, Shen'dorei Tabard 280729; 12-month subscription Tabard of Eternal Exploration 285352, Eternal Explorer's Backpack 285353, Azurky 285354; Twitch drop of the launch Pouch of Violet Dust 289439; China's Launch Collector's Annual Pass Gill'el 229368, Ensemble: Stillwater Fisher Attire 244231 and, by its description, the Adventurer's Tent 288185 (no source names the id)

phases.name: Black Market
phases.source: Items live WoW Forever sells on the Black Market Auction House (bids in gold), as the Quick Facts of Wowhead Forever's item pages say ("Sold on the Black Market", 2026-11-20): the Riding Turtle, White Tiger Cub, Hippogryph Hatchling, the Lashling Buds, Tiny Bronze Whelpling and any other page that says the same. Filled by the rule (wowhead_black_market) from the crawled pages; an item leaves it once the realm's blackmarket_template stocks it (its seller spawned) or another source gives it
